environment.description: Node.js 18 container on Kubernetes (GKE Autopilot) with pod-level annotation 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/graphql-server: runtime/default' and a custom seccomp profile loaded via 'securityContext.seccompProfile.localhostProfile: profiles/graphql-restricted.json'. The seccomp profile is a whitelist-mode profile (defaultAction: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO) that permits read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, brk, futex, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, accept4, bind, listen, clock_gettime, getpid, gettid, ioctl, fcntl, lseek, stat, readlink, access, pipe2, dup2, getdents64, newfstatat, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, sigaltstack, clone (CLONE_THREAD only), set_robust_list, prlimit64, getrandom, eventfd2, timerfd_create, timerfd_settime — but explicitly OMITS execve, execveat, fork, vfork, clone (CLONE_NEWNS|CLONE_NEWPID), ptrace, and connect/socket/sendto/recvfrom (network syscalls blocked post-bind). The profile was generated via 'kubectl gadget advise seccomp-profile' during normal operation and then manually pruned of exec-family and outbound-network syscalls.
